# HEALIX MEDICAL

> International patient coordination and communication services in Türkiye. HEALIX MEDICAL coordinates first contact, travel/hospital communication, and multilingual support across 33 contracted healthcare facilities in Türkiye. All medical diagnosis, eligibility, and treatment decisions remain exclusively with licensed hospitals and medical teams.

## Contracted Healthcare Network (33 Facilities)
- Dedicated agreement (2 facilities): Liv Hospital Ulus, Liv Hospital Vadistanbul
- MLP / Medical Park & University agreement (31 facilities): Medical Park, VM Medical Park, Liv Hospital (Ankara, Gaziantep, Samsun), İstinye Üniversitesi Tıp Fakültesi Hastanesi (including Dental Research & Application Center), and İstanbul Aydın Üniversitesi Sağlık Uygulama ve Araştırma Merkezi.
